description: Flat record-level metadata schema for X-ray phase-contrast microscopy datasets of cultured human epithelial cells exposed to ionizing radiation, including sample preparation, source and detector parameters, and image processing/correlation provenance.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record corresponding to one image, projection, volume, or derived analysis item.

dataset_sample_id.descr: Unique identifier linking the record to the biological sample or culture well/plate position.

image_id.descr: Unique identifier for the raw or processed image associated with this record.

experiment_date.descr: Date of image acquisition or experiment execution (YYYY-MM-DD).

cell_line.descr: Human epithelial cell line used, e.g., A549, HeLa, HaCaT, MCF-10A.

cell_line_source.descr: Source or vendor of the cell line, including catalog number or repository identifier if available.

donor_origin.descr: Donor origin or derivation information for primary or patient-derived epithelial cells, if applicable.

cell_type_state.descr: Cellular state at imaging, e.g., adherent, confluent, sub-confluent, synchronized, differentiated.

passage_number.descr: Cell passage number at the time of irradiation/imaging.

culture_medium.descr: Base culture medium used, including key supplements if relevant.

serum_percent.descr: Percentage of serum in culture medium, if used.

incubation_temperature_c.descr: Incubation or culture temperature in degrees Celsius.

humidity_percent.descr: Incubation humidity as percent, if controlled or recorded.

substrate_or_support.descr: Sample support used for imaging, e.g., glass coverslip, silicon nitride window, polymer membrane.

coating_material.descr: Surface coating used to promote adhesion, e.g., collagen, fibronectin, poly-L-lysine; 'none' if not used.

fixation_used.descr: Whether the sample was chemically fixed prior to imaging.

fixative_agent.descr: Fixative used, e.g., paraformaldehyde, glutaraldehyde; use 'none' if not fixed.

fixation_time_min.descr: Fixation duration in minutes, if applicable.

permeabilization_used.descr: Whether permeabilization was performed prior to staining or imaging.

permeabilization_agent.descr: Permeabilization reagent, e.g., Triton X-100, saponin; use 'none' if not applicable.

staining_used.descr: Whether contrast staining or fluorescence labeling was applied.

stain_or_label_name.descr: Name of stain/label used, e.g., phalloidin, DAPI, osmium, uranyl acetate; use 'none' if not used.

radiation_type.descr: Ionizing radiation type used for exposure, e.g., X-ray, gamma, proton; typically X-ray or gamma for this study context.

radiation_source.descr: Radiation source or generator used for exposure, including facility or device name.

radiation_energy_kev.descr: Incident radiation energy in keV, if applicable.

dose_rate_gy_per_min.descr: Dose rate in Gy/min during exposure.

time_post_exposure_h.descr: Time in hours between radiation exposure and imaging.

fractionation_scheme.descr: Description of dose fractionation, e.g., single acute dose, 2 fractions over 24 h.

oxygen_condition.descr: Oxygenation condition during irradiation, e.g., normoxia, hypoxia, anoxia.

xray_microscope_model.descr: Model or system name of the X-ray phase-contrast microscope.

beamline_or_instrument_id.descr: Beamline, facility, or instrument identifier associated with the imaging system.

xray_source_type.descr: Type of X-ray source, e.g., synchrotron, microfocus tube, laboratory source.

xray_source_power_w.descr: X-ray source power in watts, if applicable.

accelerating_voltage_kv.descr: Accelerating voltage of the X-ray source in kilovolts, if applicable.

beam_current_ma.descr: Beam current in milliamperes, if applicable.

monochromator_used.descr: Whether a monochromator was used to select the X-ray spectrum.

monochromator_type.descr: Type or model of monochromator, if used.

beam_energy_bandwidth_ev.descr: Energy bandwidth of the X-ray beam in eV, if known.

xray_energy_kev.descr: Effective X-ray imaging energy in keV.

wavelength_nm.descr: X-ray wavelength in nanometers, if derived or recorded.

source_to_sample_distance_mm.descr: Distance from X-ray source to sample in millimeters.

sample_to_detector_distance_mm.descr: Distance from sample to detector in millimeters.

phase_contrast_method.descr: Phase-contrast imaging method used, e.g., propagation-based, Zernike, grating interferometry, edge illumination.

objective_magnification.descr: Objective or optical magnification, if applicable.

pixel_size_um.descr: Effective pixel size at the sample plane in micrometers.

field_of_view_um.descr: Field of view size in micrometers, if applicable.

exposure_time_ms.descr: Detector exposure time per frame in milliseconds.

frame_averaging_count.descr: Number of frames averaged for one final image.

detector_model.descr: Detector/camera model used for image acquisition.

detector_pixel_size_um.descr: Native detector pixel size in micrometers.

detector_binning.descr: Detector binning factor used during acquisition.

image_orientation.descr: Orientation of the image relative to the sample or coordinate system, if recorded.

radiation_shielding_used.descr: Whether shielding or protective measures were used during irradiation or imaging.

rois_selected.descr: Number of regions of interest selected for analysis, if applicable.

raw_image_format.descr: File format of the raw image data, e.g., TIFF, HDF5, NIfTI, proprietary format.

processed_image_format.descr: File format of the processed/derived image data.

image_processing_workflow_name.descr: Name of the image-processing workflow or pipeline.

image_processing_software.descr: Primary software used for image processing, reconstruction, segmentation, or analysis.

image_processing_software_version.descr: Version of the software used for image processing.

image_processing_parameters.descr: Structured description of key processing parameters, e.g., filter sizes, thresholds, deconvolution settings; use a JSON-like string if needed.

registration_method.descr: Method used for image correlation/registration, e.g., rigid, affine, non-rigid, feature-based, intensity-based.

registration_reference_image_id.descr: Identifier of the reference image used for correlation/registration.

correlation_metric.descr: Metric used for image correlation, e.g., mutual information, cross-correlation, NCC.

segmentation_used.descr: Whether segmentation of cellular structures was performed.

segmentation_method.descr: Segmentation method used, e.g., thresholding, watershed, manual annotation, machine learning.

analysis_software.descr: Software used for downstream quantitative analysis.

quality_control_status.descr: QC outcome for this record, e.g., pass, warn, fail.

qc_notes.descr: Free-text notes on quality issues, artifacts, motion blur, beam damage, or acquisition anomalies.

operator_name.descr: Name or identifier of the operator who prepared the sample or acquired the image.

laboratory_name.descr: Laboratory, group, or institution responsible for the record.

protocol_reference.descr: Reference to the SOP, protocol document, or publication describing the sample preparation and imaging workflow.

license.descr: License or usage terms for the record, if applicable.

comments.descr: Additional free-text remarks relevant to interpretation or reuse of the record.
